title: Payment confirmations returning HTTP 500 after v2.14 deploy
error_signature: ERROR [payments-api] 2026-03-04T02:13:44Z PaymentController.confirm - json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0) while reading cache key 'pay:session:8f2c41'
root_cause: Redis cache invalidation bug after deploy: the new release changed the cache key format but old keys were not flushed, so services read stale or malformed cached objects.
resolution_steps: Rolled back payments-api to v2.13
Investigated database for corruption (none found)
Manually flushed Redis db 2
Redeployed v2.14

title: Checkout jobs stuck: TypeError on cart object
error_signature:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/worker/checkout.py", line 88, in process_cart
    total = cart['items_total'] + cart['shipping']
TypeError: string indices must be integers, not 'str'
root_cause: Redis cache invalidation bug after deploy: the new release changed the cache key format but old keys were not flushed, so services read stale or malformed cached objects.
resolution_steps: Found cached cart objects stored as JSON strings by the old release
Flushed cart:* keys in Redis
Restarted checkout-worker deployment

title: Users logged out instantly after login
error_signature: WARN [auth-service] SessionStore.get key=sess:v2:91ab... returned None (cache hit expected) - 4,812 occurrences in 5m; 401 Unauthorized spike on /api/me
root_cause: Redis cache invalidation bug after deploy: the new release changed the cache key format but old keys were not flushed, so services read stale or malformed cached objects.
resolution_steps: Noticed spike started 4 minutes after auth-service v5.2 deploy
Flushed sess:* keys
Restarted auth-service pods

title: Database connection pool exhausted
error_signature: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections (max_connections=200, active=200)
root_cause: Connection leak: a new reporting job opened DB connections inside a loop without closing them.
resolution_steps: Identified idle-in-transaction connections from reporting-job via pg_stat_activity
Killed leaked connections with pg_terminate_backend
Patched job to use a context manager for connections
Added pool max_overflow=10 limit

title: Payments API OOMKilled every 20 minutes
error_signature: kubelet: Container payments-api in pod payments-api-7d9f8 was OOMKilled (memory limit 1Gi, usage 1.02Gi); restartCount=14
root_cause: Memory leak: an in-process LRU cache had no max size and grew with every unique merchant ID.
resolution_steps: Captured heap snapshot with tracemalloc
Set maxsize=10000 on functools.lru_cache
Raised memory limit to 1.5Gi temporarily

title: Order queue backlog over 50,000 messages
error_signature: WARN [rabbitmq] queue 'orders.checkout' messages_ready=52341 consumers=2 publish_rate=410/s deliver_rate=35/s
root_cause: Queue backlog: autoscaler was disabled during a cost-saving change, leaving only 2 consumers for peak traffic.
resolution_steps: Re-enabled HPA for checkout-worker (min 4, max 20)
Scaled to 16 replicas manually
Monitored backlog drain to zero

title: Refund endpoint returns KeyError 'currency'
error_signature: ERROR [payments-api] RefundService.create - KeyError: 'currency' at refunds.py:142 (object loaded from cache key 'pay:txn:v1:55e10')
root_cause: Redis cache invalidation bug after deploy: the new release changed the cache key format but old keys were not flushed, so services read stale or malformed cached objects.
resolution_steps: Confirm a deploy happened in the last 30 minutes (check the release dashboard)
Flush the affected Redis keyspace: redis-cli -n 2 --scan --pattern 'v1:*' | xargs redis-cli -n 2 DEL
Restart the service pods so in-memory caches are rebuilt
Verify error rate drops below 0.1% on the service dashboard

title: OAuth login fails with invalid_client
error_signature: ERROR [auth-service] OAuthCallback - invalid_client: client_secret mismatch for client_id=web-prod (provider responded 401)
root_cause: Bad config: rotated OAuth client secret was updated in the vault but the auth-service ConfigMap still referenced the old version.
resolution_steps: Compared secret version in vault vs pod env
Updated ConfigMap to the new secret version
Rolling restart of auth-service

title: Slow queries: profile page taking 9 seconds
error_signature: LOG: duration: 9214.332 ms statement: SELECT * FROM user_profiles WHERE lower(email) = lower($1)
root_cause: Missing index: a new query used lower(email) but only a plain email index existed.
resolution_steps: Ran EXPLAIN ANALYZE and found a sequential scan
Created index CONCURRENTLY on lower(email)
Confirmed query time under 15ms

title: Duplicate orders created during retry storm
error_signature: WARN [checkout-worker] idempotency key missing for order_id=ord_88213; message redelivered 3 times (x-death count=3)
root_cause: Bad config: consumer ack timeout set below average processing time, causing redelivery and double processing.
resolution_steps: Raised consumer ack timeout from 5s to 60s
Added idempotency key check before order insert
Refunded 37 duplicate orders

title: Stripe webhook signature verification failing
error_signature: stripe.error.SignatureVerificationError: No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload
root_cause: Bad config: webhook signing secret not updated after a new webhook endpoint was created in the Stripe dashboard.
resolution_steps: Copied the new signing secret into the vault
Restarted payments-api
Replayed failed webhooks from the Stripe dashboard

title: Disk full on primary database
error_signature: PANIC: could not write to file "pg_wal/xlogtemp.112": No space left on device
root_cause: Disk exhaustion: WAL files piled up because a replication slot for a decommissioned replica was never dropped.
resolution_steps: Identified inactive replication slot via pg_replication_slots
Dropped the stale slot
Expanded volume by 100GB
Added disk usage alert at 80%

title: Rate limiter blocking all logins
error_signature: 429 Too Many Requests: rate limit exceeded for key=ip:10.0.0.1 (limit 100/min)
root_cause: Bad config: rate limiter keyed by load balancer IP instead of X-Forwarded-For, so every user shared one bucket.
resolution_steps: Switched limiter key to the X-Forwarded-For header
Flushed rate limit counters
Deployed hotfix

title: Worker crash loop: memory overflow parsing large carts
error_signature: MemoryError at worker/checkout.py:51 in load_cart_snapshot (cart size 48MB); CrashLoopBackOff
root_cause: Memory overflow: a bot created carts with thousands of items and the worker loaded full snapshots into memory.
resolution_steps: Added max 200 items per cart validation
Streamed cart snapshots instead of loading fully
Blocked the bot user agent at the WAF

title: Currency conversion returning zero
error_signature: ERROR [payments-api] FxService.convert - rate for INR->USD is 0.0 (provider response stale since 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z)
root_cause: Third-party outage: FX rate provider returned stale data and the service had no fallback.
resolution_steps: Switched to secondary FX provider
Added staleness check (reject rates older than 1h)
Recalculated 212 affected payments

title: Replication lag 15 minutes on read replica
error_signature: WARN replica lag: 912 seconds behind primary (replay_lsn 3F/2A0012C8)
root_cause: Heavy migration: an ALTER TABLE rewrite on a large table generated massive WAL during business hours.
resolution_steps: Paused the migration
Routed reads to primary temporarily
Rescheduled migration for low traffic window with pg_repack

title: Payments timing out to bank gateway
error_signature: requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='gateway.bankpartner.in', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=5)
root_cause: Third-party latency: partner bank gateway degraded; the client timeout was too short with no retry.
resolution_steps: Increased timeout to 15s with 2 retries and exponential backoff
Enabled circuit breaker to queue payments
Notified partner bank

title: Queue consumers disconnected after broker upgrade
error_signature: pika.exceptions.ConnectionClosedByBroker: (320, "CONNECTION_FORCED - broker forced connection closure with reason 'shutdown'")
root_cause: Queue backlog: workers had no reconnect logic, so they stayed disconnected after the broker restarted during an upgrade.
resolution_steps: Restarted checkout-worker pods to reconnect
Added automatic reconnect with backoff to the consumer
Verified backlog drained
